children: Info Edge, the parent company of Naukri, has announced a leadership reshuffle, appointing Himanshu Agarwal as its new chief financial officer (CFO) and former Adobe Systems India Managing Director Naresh Chand Gupta as an independent director, according to media reports.

Agarwal will assume charge as CFO from September 17 and will also join Info Edge’s board as an additional director. He is subsequently expected to take charge as a whole-time director and CFO, subject to the required approvals, as per media reports.

Agarwal brings more than three decades of experience across finance, corporate governance, mergers and acquisitions and business transformation, with experience spanning companies in India and overseas.
Meanwhile, Gupta, the former Managing Director of Adobe Systems India, will join Info Edge’s board as an independent director from October 1 for a five-year term, subject to shareholder approval.

Gupta is currently associated with Accuracap Technologies and Accuracap Consultancy Services. He also serves as an independent director on the boards of eClerx Services and NoPaperForms. He had previously served as an independent director at Info Edge until March 2023.
The leadership transition will also see Ambarish Raghuvanshi step down as Info Edge’s interim CFO. Raghuvanshi has held the position since November 2025 and will conclude his tenure on September 16.
However, Raghuvanshi will continue to advise the company in a finance advisory role until October 31, supporting the transition and handover to Agarwal.
Info Edge has also appointed Agarwal to its Risk Management Committee and Business Responsibility and Sustainability Reporting Committee.
